lines.japanese: 「おっはよーごっざいまー……」
lines.english: “Gooood morniiing...”

lines.japanese: 更衣室へ入ると同時に、微妙な空気を感じた。
lines.english: The instant I entered the changing room, I felt an awkward tension in the air.

lines.japanese: 「おっ、千歳ー。おっはよー」
lines.english: “Oh, Chitose. Morning.”

lines.japanese: 「おはようございます」
lines.english: “Good morning.”

lines.japanese: ああ、玉泉日和子と日野英里子が密室にふたりきりだったのか。さもありなん、だな。
lines.english: Ah. Hiyoko Tamaizumi and Eriko Hino had been alone together in the changing room. No wonder.

lines.japanese: たったいまユニフォームに着替えて更衣室から出てきた感じの両者。
lines.english: They both looked like they'd just changed into their uniforms and come out.

lines.japanese: 日野英里子はそのままソファーにぼすんと座り、かたや玉泉日和子は──
lines.english: Eriko Hino dropped heavily onto the sofa. Hiyoko Tamaizumi, meanwhile—

lines.japanese: 「私、先にフロアの方へ入ってます」
lines.english: “I'll go out to the floor first.”

lines.japanese: ──会釈程度についっと頭を下げて、さっさと労働開始と言った態。いつもながら対照的だなあ。
lines.english: —gave the barest nod and briskly set off to work. As always, they could hardly have been more different.

lines.japanese: 軽部店長から仰せつかった俺の役目は、職場の摩擦を多少なりと減らす潤滑油であって、このふたりの接着剤ではない──
lines.english: Manager Karube had assigned me to serve as a lubricant, reducing friction in the workplace to some degree. I was not the adhesive meant to glue these two together—

lines.japanese: 「玉泉のひと、たまには一緒にお茶でもどうだ」
lines.english: “Tamaizumi, why don't you stay and have tea with us for once?”

lines.japanese: ──ないのだけど、やはり気になってしまう俺だった。
lines.english: —and yet I could not help worrying about them.

lines.japanese: だってさ！　だってさ！　ねー、みんななかよしの方がいいじゃんかー？
lines.english: Because! Because! Come on, isn't it better when everybody gets along?

lines.japanese: 「なに、たまひよも一服してから行く？　紅茶淹れたげよっか」
lines.english: “What, Tama-chick? Gonna take a breather first? Want me to make you tea?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、結構です。おふたりでどうぞ」
lines.english: “No, thank you. Please enjoy it together.”

lines.japanese: 拒否された。うーん、いつもながら冷たいなあ。いや、俺（ていうか鷲介）のせいもあるんだろうけどさ。
lines.english: Rejected. Hmm. Cold as ever. Though I—or rather, Shusuke—was partly to blame.

lines.japanese: 「ふーん、まあいっか。じゃあ千歳ー、おまえの分の紅茶淹れとくよ」
lines.english: “Hmm. Fine, then. Chitose, I'll make you a cup.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ！　マジすか英里子さん、今日はなんか気配りのできる女をアピールする必要にでも迫られてるんすか！」
lines.english: “What!? Seriously, Eriko? What has you so desperate to prove you can be considerate today?”

lines.japanese: 「バーカ、私はいっつも後輩に優し……あれっ？　なんだこの箱、さっきまであったっけ？　これ持ってきたのたまひよ？」
lines.english: “Idiot. I'm *always* nice to the younger staff... Huh? What's this box? Was it here a second ago? You bring it, Tama-chick?”

lines.japanese: 「はい？」
lines.english: “Excuse me?”

lines.japanese: ドアノブに手をかけていた玉泉日和子が振りかえる。日野英里子が一辺３０センチぐらいの（ほぼ）立方体を見下ろしていた。
lines.english: Hiyoko Tamaizumi, one hand already on the doorknob, looked back. Eriko Hino was gazing down at an almost perfect cube about a foot on each side.

lines.japanese: そして持ち主も分からないというのに、次の瞬間にはもう開けていた。
lines.english: Though she did not know whose it was, by the next instant she had already opened it.

lines.japanese: 「おおー、ケーキじゃん」
lines.english: “Oh! Cake.”

lines.japanese: 「ケーキ？」
lines.english: “Cake?”

lines.japanese: 「うひょー！　兄ちゃんケーキ大好きだいねー」
lines.english: “Whoaaa! Big Brother loooves cake!”

lines.japanese: 日頃こそ男気溢れるハードボイルドで知られる俺だが、ひとたびハニーなスイーツを小悪魔チェックすれば、たちどころに愛され上手のモテかわガールへキラキラチェンジアップするのだ。
lines.english: Ordinarily, of course, I was renowned for hard-boiled masculine grit. But the instant my naughty-girl eye fell on a honey-sweet treat, I sparkled into the kind of irresistible cutie everyone just had to love.

lines.japanese: 見れば箱の中には、バラエティ豊かな六種類のケーキが色とりどりに詰まっていた。
lines.english: The box held six vividly colored cakes in a wide variety of styles.

lines.japanese: 「ふう、いかんいかん、百円玉の補充を忘れていたとは……」
lines.english: “Whew. That won’t do. Forgot to restock the hundred-yen coins...”

lines.japanese: 「おっ、おはようみんな。今日もよろしく頼むぞ」
lines.english: “Oh! Morning, everyone. I’m counting on you today.”

lines.japanese: 慌ただしげに現れた軽部狩男は、箱の周りに群がった俺たちを尻目に、金庫の中から百円玉のロールを取りだしてそのままＵターンした。
lines.english: Karuo Karube hurried in. Paying no attention to us clustered around the box, he removed a roll of hundred-yen coins from the safe and immediately made a U-turn.

lines.japanese: 「てんちょー、このケーキなんすか？」
lines.english: “Manager, what's with the cake?”

lines.japanese: 「んっ？」
lines.english: “Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、それか。さっき本部の連中が来て、新メニューの試供品だと言って置いていった。どうせ俺ひとりじゃ食いきれんから、おまえたちで片付けてしまえ。あとで感想だけ聞かせてくれよ」
lines.english: “Ah, that. Some people from head office stopped by earlier and left these as samples for a new menu. I can’t eat them all myself, so you lot can finish them off. Just tell me what you thought afterward.”

lines.japanese: 彼は手早く質問にだけ答えると、すぐまたフロアへ戻っていった。
lines.english: Having answered the question with brisk efficiency, he immediately returned to the floor.

lines.japanese: 「ふうむ。軽部店長のひとも、お客さんを待たせてるときぐらいは真面目な働きをするのですなあ」
lines.english: “Hmm. So even Manager Karube can take his job seriously when he has customers waiting.”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、ふたりとも、いまのちょっと感心──」
lines.english: “Did you two see that? I'm a little impres—”

lines.japanese: ──おわぅ。
lines.english: —whoa.

lines.japanese: な、なんだこの、女ふたりのあいだに流れる微妙な緊張感は……。
lines.english: Wh-what was this strange tension running between the two women...?

lines.japanese: 「たまひよ、先にフロア入るんでしょ。早く行きなよ」
lines.english: “Tama-chick, weren't you going to start work? Hurry up.”

lines.japanese: 見てる。明らかに見てる。玉泉日和子がケーキちらっちら見てる。
lines.english: She was looking. Obviously looking. Hiyoko Tamaizumi kept flicking glance after glance at the cake.

lines.japanese: 「……ええ、そう思ったんですけど、たまにはゆっくり入るのもいいですよね」
lines.english: “...Yes, that was my intention. But I suppose there is no harm in starting a little more slowly once in a while.”

lines.japanese: ほう？　思わず日野英里子と目配せを交わしてしまった。にやり。計ったように笑顔を浮かべる俺たち。
lines.english: Oh? Eriko Hino and I exchanged a glance without thinking, then grinned in perfect unison.

lines.japanese: そしてまず日野英里子が、白々しくケーキ箱を玉泉日和子から遠ざけた。
lines.english: Eriko Hino began by ostentatiously moving the cake box farther away from Hiyoko Tamaizumi.

lines.japanese: 「ふーんそうなの、じゃあそっちの椅子にでも座ればあ？　おーい千歳ー、店長がああ言ってるから、このケーキさっそく食べよーよ」
lines.english: “Oh, is that so? Then sit in that chair over there or something. Heeey, Chitose. Manager said we could, so let's eat this cake right now.”

lines.japanese: 続いて俺が無闇にはしゃぐ。
lines.english: Next, I grew needlessly excited.

lines.japanese: 「わあい、ケーキ！　ケーキ！　美味しいケーキ！　うーん、でも、いくらなんでも数が多すぎっすよねえ。俺と英里子さんだけで六つも食べきれないっすよねえ。誰かもうひとり協力してくれないっすかねえ」
lines.english: “Yaaay, cake! Cake! Delicious cake! Hmm, but this is way too much cake, don't you think? There's no way Eriko and I can finish all six by ourselves, right? If only one more person would help us out...”

lines.japanese: キィ……とすん。
lines.english: Squeak... thump.

lines.japanese: 無表情のままキャスター付き回転椅子に腰かける玉泉日和子。その視線がじっと一点を凝視していた。
lines.english: Without a trace of expression, Hiyoko Tamaizumi sat in a wheeled swivel chair. Her gaze fixed unwaveringly upon a single point.

lines.japanese: 「いぇーい、ケーキっ、ケーキっ！　ほら千歳、紅茶淹れたよー。砂糖いくつ？」
lines.english: “Yaaay! Cake, cake! Chitose, I made your tea. How many sugars?”

lines.japanese: 「はーい、ひとつでお願いしまーす！　俺はお皿とフォークを用意しましたー！」
lines.english: “One, please! I brought the plates and forks!”

lines.japanese: 「千歳はどれにするどれにする？　私はじゃあ……モンブランにしよっと！　きゃっきゃっ！」
lines.english: “Which one, Chitose? Which one? Then I'll have... the Mont Blanc! Squee!”

lines.japanese: 「うう～ん、あたしはやっぱりイチゴかしらぁ……や～ん迷っちゃうわ～、きゃっきゃっ！」
lines.english: “Mmmmm, I suppose *I'll* have strawberryyy... Ohhh, how will I ever chooose? Squee, squee!”

lines.japanese: 「あの」
lines.english: “Excuse me.”

lines.japanese: 箱の底へ手を伸ばしたところで声が挟まれた。さっきまで横向きだった玉泉日和子の鉄仮面が、いつの間にか正面を向いている。
lines.english: Just as my hand reached into the box, her voice intervened. Hiyoko Tamaizumi's iron mask, turned sideways a moment before, now faced us directly.

lines.japanese: 「いま思いだしたんですけど、先ほど店長は『感想を聞きたい』と仰ってました。ということは、これは業務の一環と考えた方がいいのではないでしょうか」
lines.english: “I just remembered that the manager said he wanted our impressions. In that case, should we not regard this as part of our duties?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。で？」
lines.english: “Sure. And?”

lines.japanese: 「失礼ですが、お二人よりも文章を書くことに慣れている私が参加しないのは不自然です。というわけで、不本意ながら私も一ついただきます」
lines.english: “Forgive me, but I am more accustomed to writing than either of you. It would make little sense for me not to participate. Therefore, against my better judgment, I shall take one as well.”

lines.japanese: ころころころ。乗用玩具を転がす幼児みたいに、玉泉日和子が椅子ごと近付いてきた。
lines.english: Roll, roll. Like a toddler propelling a ride-on toy, Hiyoko Tamaizumi approached without leaving her chair.

lines.japanese: ぷくく。俺と日野英里子はふたたび視線を交わした。
lines.english: Pfft. Eriko Hino and I exchanged another glance.

lines.japanese: 「あーはいはい、たまひよも食べるのね。最初から言えば紅茶の用意もしたのにさあ」
lines.english: “Right, right. Tama-chick wants cake too. If you'd said so from the start, I would've made tea for you.”

lines.japanese: 「砂糖は一つでお願いします」
lines.english: “One sugar, please.”

lines.japanese: おまえ業務の一環とか面倒くさいこと言って、やっぱフツーにくつろぐ気まんまんじゃねえか。
lines.english: You went on about it being part of your job, but you were planning to just kick back all along, weren't you?

lines.japanese: 「で、たまひよはどれにすんの？　私はモンブランな」
lines.english: “So which one do you want, Tama-chick? The Mont Blanc is mine.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、私はイチゴ――」
lines.english: “Yes. I shall take the strawberry—”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ日野英里子さん。俺たちはただおやつとして食うだけだけど、玉泉のひとは業務の一環として試食モニターをするんだそうです。だったら彼女には、人気なさそうなやつを食べてもらいましょう」
lines.english: “Oh, Eriko. You and I are merely having a snack, but Tamaizumi says she is conducting an official taste test. In that case, she ought to eat whichever one looks least popular.”

lines.japanese: 「お、千歳冴えてんじゃん。だったらこの、よく分かんない緑のもさもさしたやつヨロ～」
lines.english: “Oh, good thinking, Chitose. In that case, you deal with this weird shaggy green one, 'kay?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、抹茶は嫌いです」
lines.english: “No. I dislike green tea.”

lines.japanese: 試食係は手を交差させて言った。
lines.english: The designated taste tester spoke with her forearms crossed in refusal.

lines.japanese: 「だったらこっちのブルーベリーのやつでいいか」
lines.english: “Then I guess this blueberry one'll do.”

lines.japanese: 「今日のアンラッキーカラーが紫なんです。変えてください」
lines.english: “Purple is my unlucky color today. Please choose another.”

lines.japanese: 試食係は首を横に振りながら言った。
lines.english: The designated taste tester spoke while shaking her head.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ仕方ないなあ、私のモンブランあげるよ。それでいいでしょ」
lines.english: “Can't be helped, then. You can have my Mont Blanc. That's fine, right?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、英里子さんの食べたいケーキを私がいただくわけにはいきません。どうぞ食べてください」
lines.english: “No. I could not take the cake you wanted, Eriko. Please eat it.”

lines.japanese: 試食係はストロベリーショートケーキを凝視しながら言った。
lines.english: The designated taste tester spoke while staring fixedly at the strawberry shortcake.

lines.japanese: ぷくくく。俺と日野英里子はよこしまな笑みを浮かべた。
lines.english: Pffft. Eriko Hino and I smiled with shared wickedness.

lines.japanese: 「さーてと！　じゃあ俺は、ストロベリーショートケーキでもいただこうかなっ」
lines.english: “Well, then! I think I'll take the strawberry shortcake!”

lines.japanese: 「待ってください！」
lines.english: “Wait!”

lines.japanese: 「やだ」
lines.english: “Nope.”

lines.japanese: あーんと口を開けて喰らいつく、というフェイント。
lines.english: I opened my mouth wide and lunged as if to take a bite—a feint.

lines.japanese: 「うん？　おいおいどうした、そんな物欲しそうな目で。はっ！　まさかおまえ、業務の一環としてモニターするだけなのに、ケーキの種類を選り好みするつもりなのかっ？」
lines.english: “Hmm? Hey, what's with those hungry eyes? Aha! Don't tell me you're planning to pick and choose which cake you get when you're only taste-testing them as part of your official duties?”

lines.japanese: 玉泉日和子の歯噛みする音が聞こえてきそうだった。
lines.english: I could almost hear Hiyoko Tamaizumi grinding her teeth.

lines.japanese: 「ははは、素直になりなさい玉泉日和子。業務ではなくおやつですと正直に言えば、ふふん、俺のストショーを譲ってやらんこともない」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! Be honest, Hiyoko Tamaizumi. Admit this is a snack and not official business, and perhaps—hmph—I might be persuaded to surrender my strawberry shortie.”

lines.japanese: 「なんですか、そんなにイチゴが食べたいんですか！　だったらはっきりそう言えばいいじゃないですか！」
lines.english: “What is this? Do you want the strawberry that badly? Then why don't you simply say so!”

lines.japanese: 「自分のことは棚に上げ！？」
lines.english: “And you say that with a straight face!?”

lines.japanese: 「いいから、その緑のもさもさでも食べててください。もう仕事が始まります」
lines.english: “Just eat the shaggy green one. Work is about to begin.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、仕事？　そんなんひとりで行け。シュパァーっと行け。俺はストショー食いまくる仕事で忙しいんだよブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Huh? Work? Go on your own. Zip off and do it. I’m busy with my job of eating all the strawberry shortcake I can. I’ll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「まあまあ千歳、ここはたまひよに譲ってやれよ」
lines.english: “Come on, Chitose. Let Tama-chick have it.”

lines.japanese: もう充分楽しんだのか、日野英里子が俺の苺ショートを拾いあげ、ぽんっと玉泉日和子の皿へと移した。なんだかんだで、後輩に優しいってのは本当なのかもしれない。
lines.english: Having apparently enjoyed the game enough, Eriko Hino picked up my strawberry shortcake and plopped it onto Hiyoko Tamaizumi's plate. Perhaps she truly was kind to her juniors after all.

lines.japanese: 「ありがとうございます、英里子さん。これで社会の秩序は保たれました」
lines.english: “Thank you, Eriko. The social order has been preserved.”

lines.japanese: そんなんで玉泉日和子は満足したようだ。
lines.english: That appeared to satisfy Hiyoko Tamaizumi.

lines.japanese: まったくもう、一言ちょうだいって言えば済むのに、なんだか女版隼人みたいなひとだなあ。ま、そんなとこが可愛いんすけどね。ばふん、ダヴ姫の方が億倍かわいいわ。あーコラー、おまいらケンカすんなてー。
lines.english: Honestly. All she had to do was say, *Give it to me*. She was like a female Hayato. Though that part of her was rather cute. Bah! Princess Dove is a hundred million times cuter. Hey, you two, no fighting in there.

lines.japanese: 「やっぽーん！　みんなたち元気かーい？　店長にケーキがあるって言われたから、客の分際で事務室まで遊びにきちゃったよー」
lines.english: “Yappooon! How's all you peoples doin'? The manager said there was cake, so I came to hang out in the office even though I'm just a customer!”

lines.japanese: 「あっ」
lines.english: “Ah.”

lines.japanese: ぷすり　ひょいぱく　あむあむあむ……。
lines.english: Stab. Lift. Chomp. Munch munch munch...

lines.japanese: 突如あらわれた無敵のイチゴ娘は、玉泉日和子が勝ちえた戦利品を一瞬でたいらげてしまった。
lines.english: The invincible Strawberry Girl appeared without warning and annihilated Hiyoko Tamaizumi's hard-won spoils in an instant.

lines.japanese: 生きた氷像を見た気がした。
lines.english: I thought I had just seen a living ice sculpture.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんねー、ひよちゃんごめんねー。苺なら今度、山ほど持ってきてあげるから許してよー」
lines.english: “I'm sorry, Hiyo! So sorry! I'll bring you a whole mountain of strawberries next time, so forgive me!”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、大丈夫です。偶発的な事故ですからこれっぽっちも気にしていません」
lines.english: “No, it is quite all right. It was an accidental incident. It does not trouble me in the slightest.”

lines.japanese: 「ありー？　ひよねーちゃん、ほっぺピクピクしてるよー」
lines.english: “Huh? Hiyo, your cheek's twitching.”

lines.japanese: 「あーん、ごめんよー。悪気はぜんぜんなかったんだよー」
lines.english: “Oh, I'm sorry! I didn't mean anything bad by it!”

lines.japanese: 「紀奈子さん駄目だよー？　悪気がないで済まされるのはあと二年が限界だからねー？」
lines.english: “Come on, Kinako. You've got, what, two years left before ‘I didn't mean it’ stops getting you off the hook?”

lines.japanese: 「うわーん、えりちゃんひどーい！　ホントに悪気なかったのにーい！」
lines.english: “Waaah! Eri, you're awful! I really didn't mean anything bad!”

lines.japanese: 悪気がなかったらしい望月紀奈子は、カウンター席に陣取り、背後を玉泉日和子が通りすぎるたび平身低頭していた。
lines.english: Kinako Mochizuki, who apparently had meant no harm, established herself at the counter and bowed almost to the floor every time Hiyoko Tamaizumi passed behind her.

lines.japanese: 玉泉日和子は口でこそ「いいええ」「ぜんぜん」「気にしないでください」を繰りかえしているが、あきらかに上手く笑えていない。意外と心の狭い女だ。狭泉だ。
lines.english: Hiyoko Tamaizumi kept repeating *No*, *not at all*, and *please don't worry*, but plainly could not make the smile work. Surprisingly narrow-hearted. Narrowizumi.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんねー。先週もひよちゃんのドーナツって知らないまま、まるっと二ついっちゃったばっかりなのに、またしてもごめんねー」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. Just last week I ate two whole doughnuts without knowing they were yours, Hiyo, and now I've done it again. I'm sorry!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、今回だけじゃないのね」
lines.english: “Oh. So this wasn't the first time.”

lines.japanese: そりゃ狭泉じゃなくても引きつるか。
lines.english: In that case, even someone other than Narrowizumi might twitch.

lines.japanese: 「ちなみに全何個中の二つをまるっと？」
lines.english: “Two doughnuts out of how many, exactly?”

lines.japanese: 「三個です」
lines.english: “Three.”

lines.japanese: 「あーっ！　ちがっ、違うの、違うんだよー」
lines.english: “Ah! No, that's not—it's not what it sounds like!”

lines.japanese: 違うらしい。しかし何が違うかの説明はとくになかった。
lines.english: Apparently it was different. She offered no explanation of how.

lines.japanese: 「もういいですよ、紀奈子さん。本気で怒ってはいませんから」
lines.english: “It’s all right, Kinako. I’m not really angry.”

lines.japanese: 「つまり軽めには怒ってるのか」
lines.english: “So you're mildly angry.”

lines.japanese: 「違います。少し残念だっただけです」
lines.english: “No. Merely a little disappointed.”

lines.japanese: 「ううー、ホントにごめんねひよちゃん……」
lines.english: “Ngh. I'm really sorry, Hiyo...”

lines.japanese: 「いいんです。千歳さんの口に入ったわけでもなし、彼らも紀奈子さんに食べてもらえて幸せでしょう」
lines.english: “It is quite all right. At least they did not go into Mr. Chitose's mouth. I am sure they were happy to be eaten by you.”

lines.japanese: 「食われたくない男ナンバーワン！？」
lines.english: “I’m the number-one guy cakes don’t want to be eaten by!?”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、そうだ！　じゃあお詫びにみんなでカラオケ行こうよ！　一人２５００円で歌いたい放題のところがあるんだよ、私会員カード持ってるし」
lines.english: “Oh, I know! To apologize, let's all go to karaoke! I know a place with unlimited singing for twenty-five hundred yen each. I have a membership card too.”

lines.japanese: 「あの……それは紀奈子さんが行きたいだけですよね」
lines.english: “Um... You simply want to go yourself, don't you?”

lines.japanese: 「しかもお詫びとか言ってワリカンかよ！」
lines.english: “And she calls it an apology, but wants to split the bill!”

lines.japanese: 「そしてそう言ってる間にもケータイ片手に予約する気満々だ！」
lines.english: “And while we're talking, she's already got her phone out, ready to make a reservation!”

lines.japanese: 「うむ、金曜日の夜は、いまから予約しなければとても部屋を取れないからな」
lines.english: “Indeed. On a Friday night, securing a room will be impossible unless we reserve it now.”

lines.japanese: 「やあ軽部店長、相変わらずするりと会話に紛れこんできますね。しかも誘われてないのにちゃっかりメンツに加わっていますね」
lines.english: “Oh, hello, Manager Karube. Sliding right into the conversation as usual, I see. And look at you joining the group even though nobody invited you.”

lines.japanese: 「だがカラオケと聞いては黙ってられないぞ！　この男子一人楽坊と異名をとる伝説のソロプロジェクトが週末の夜を華麗にいろど──」
lines.english: “But I cannot remain silent when I hear the word *karaoke*! The legendary solo act known as One-Man Girls Band shall adorn the weekend night in splen—”

lines.japanese: 「──あ。もちろん店閉めてからの開始だから、やっぱオールになっちゃうんすかね」
lines.english: “—oh. Of course we're starting after closing, so this will be an all-nighter, won't it?”

lines.japanese: 「あの、すみません私、夜通しはちょっと──」
lines.english: “Um, I'm sorry, but staying all night would be a little—”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ！　せっかくだから親睦会という名目で、払いはすべて俺がもとう」
lines.english: “I have it! Let us call it a staff social, and I shall pay the entire bill.”

lines.japanese: 「──そこまで言うなら行きます」
lines.english: —If you insist on going that far, I will attend.

lines.japanese: 「行くんだ！？」
lines.english: “You will!?”

lines.japanese: 意外だな。仕事仲間と歌って騒いでなんて、いかにも嫌いそうなのに。ひょっとして俺は、玉泉日和子の本質をぜんぜん理解できていなかったのだろうか。
lines.english: How unexpected. Singing and carrying on with coworkers seemed precisely the sort of thing she would hate. Had I failed completely to understand Hiyoko Tamaizumi's true nature?

lines.japanese: 「へえー、店長太っ腹じゃん。よーし、アレックス２の初舞台だね紀奈子さん！」
lines.english: “Wow, Manager, that's generous. All right! Alex Two makes its stage debut tonight, Kinako!”

lines.japanese: 「なんだ、そのアレックス２というのは」
lines.english: “What is this Alex Two?”

lines.japanese: 「私とえりちゃんの期間限定ユニットでーす☆」
lines.english: “Eri and I formed a limited-time unit☆”

lines.japanese: 「なんだってえ！　よし、負けないぞ。おい玉泉のひと、対抗して俺たちもペアを組もう。ユニット名は玉泉日和子と千歳鷲介をもじって『タマタマ☆スケスケ』だ」
lines.english: “What!? All right, we're not losing this one. Hey, Tamaizumi person, let's team up and take them on. We'll mash the names Hiyoko Tamaizumi and Shusuke Chitose together and call ourselves ‘Balls-Out☆See-Through’!”

lines.japanese: 「本日中に解散してください」
lines.english: “Disband before the day is over.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふふ、みんな盛り上がってきたな！　ようし、歌え！　踊れ！　アレキサンダー花水木通り店のミッドナイト・パーティーだ！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! Now everybody's getting into it! Good! Sing! Dance! Welcome to Alexander Dogwood Street's Midnight Party!”

lines.japanese: 「あれえマスター、なんか楽しそうじゃん、俺も入れてよ」
lines.english: “Hey, boss. Sounds like fun. Let me in.”

lines.japanese: 「おおカケル、いまちょうど『爆唱！　冬だ一番カラオケまつり』の企画会議がまとまったところだ」
lines.english: “Ah, Kakeru. We have just concluded our planning session for ‘Scream Your Lungs Out! Winter's Biggest Karaoke Festival.’”

lines.japanese: みんなできゃいきゃい盛りあがっていたら、ふらりと鳳翔が入ってきた。
lines.english: While everyone chattered excitedly, Kakeru Otori wandered in.

lines.japanese: その瞬間、俺は異なる三つのクオリアを得ていた。鷲介にとってのカケルくん、隼人にとっての鳳、伽楼羅にとってのフェニックス。
lines.english: In that instant, I received three distinct qualia: Shusuke's Kakeru, Hayato's Otori, and Karura's Phoenix.

lines.japanese: 針生蔵人を交えて薄暗い路地裏で暴れた、あの日以来の再会だった。
lines.english: This was our first encounter since the day Kurodo Hariu joined us in raising hell in a dim back alley.

lines.japanese: 俺は一瞬、対応に迷った。伊丹伽楼羅に御執心な彼のこと、いまの俺の状態を知ったらどう動くだろう。万一こんな場所で騒ぎを起こされたら最悪だ。この場だけでもいいから、なんとか誤魔化したい。
lines.english: For an instant, I could not decide how to respond. Given his fixation on Karura Itami, what would he do if he learned of my present condition? A disturbance here would be disastrous. I needed to bluff him, if only for the moment.

lines.japanese: 「あははは、何おまえアレキサンダーの制服なんか着てんだよ、似合わねえなあ……つか、チューニング合わせろとは言ったけど、順応しすぎ──」
lines.english: “Ahahaha! Why're you wearing an Alexander uniform? Doesn't suit you at all... I told you to tune yourself to the right frequency, but this is over-adapting—”

lines.japanese: 「さ、さようか、歌唱会とな！　うぉんむうぉんむ、庶民どもに我が美声を聞かせたるでえー。も、もははー、ゆくぞフェニックス、らもらもと歌えー！」
lines.english: “S-so there shall be a gathering of song! Wom-wom, wom-wom! We shall let the rabble hear Our beautiful voice! M-mohaha! Come, Phoenix—sing it ramo-ramo!”

lines.japanese: 「──あれ、おまえ誰？」
lines.english: “—wait. Who are you?”

lines.japanese: 伽楼羅１００％になりきろうとしたが、あっさり見破られてしまった。もはは、さすがフェニックス、伝説の宝具『真実の鏡』を持っておるようだのう。
lines.english: I attempted to become one hundred percent Karura, but he saw through me at once. Mohaha. As expected of the Phoenix. He must possess the legendary treasure called the Mirror of Truth.

lines.japanese: 「は？　なに言ってんのカケル、どっから見ても千歳じゃん」
lines.english: “What? What are you talking about, Kakeru? That's obviously Chitose.”

lines.japanese: ……ま、仕方ないか。どのみち彼を不誠実に欺くのは、俺の中の５分の２が好ましく思っていない。ここは観念して成行きに任せよう。
lines.english: ...Well. It could not be helped. In any case, two-fifths of me disliked the idea of deceiving him. I would surrender and let events take their course.

lines.japanese: 「その通り。俺は千歳鷲介だな、少なくとも一面的には」
lines.english: “Correct. I am Shusuke Chitose—at least from one perspective.”

lines.japanese: 「……なんだその冗談。笑えねえ」
lines.english: “...What kind of joke is that? It isn't funny.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　上等だコラ。俺のクールな冗談は、おまえみてーなクソ金髪にゃ理解できねンだよ。ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Huh? Fine by me, asshole. A blond piece of shit like you can't understand my cool jokes. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ……このふたりケンカでもしたの？　なんか雰囲気おかしいね」
lines.english: “Huh...? Did these two have a fight? Something feels weird.”

lines.japanese: 「アハハ……あんだけひとに期待させといて、もう満足しましたなんてことないよなァ？」
lines.english: “Ahaha... You didn't get me all excited just to turn around and tell me you're satisfied already, did you?”

lines.japanese: 「なあ？」
lines.english: “Well?”

lines.japanese: 「なあ……笑えねえぞ、伽楼羅ァ！」
lines.english: “Come on... This isn't funny, Karura!”

lines.japanese: 鳳翔は俺の襟首を掴んで捻りあげた。一瞬にして空気が凍る。
lines.english: Kakeru Otori seized my collar and wrenched it upward. The room froze in an instant.

lines.japanese: 「ひっ」
lines.english: “Eek!”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、ちょっと！　何いきなりキレてんの、今日のホーくん変だよ！」
lines.english: “H-hey! Why are you suddenly losing it? You're acting strange today, Kakeru!”

lines.japanese: 「そーそー、変よおカケルくん？　やだなあ、みんな怖がっちゃってんじゃない。ホラもう、手ぇ放す放す」
lines.english: “Riiight, riiight, you're acting weeeird, Kakeru. Oh, come ooon, you're scaring everybody. There, there, let go now.”

lines.japanese: 「目ぇ覚ませよ、なに日和ってンだァ？　クク、気付けの一発めぐんでやろうかァ」
lines.english: “Wake up. Why're you going soft? Heh. Want a shot to clear your head?”

lines.japanese: 「ばふん！　田舎貴族が一端の口を利くようになったのうフェニックス。だがな我が友、奈落の名に懸けて、貴様ごとき惰弱なゴブフォおおっ！」
lines.english: “Bah! You have grown bold for a rustic noble, Phoenix. Yet, my friend, upon the name of the Abyss, a feeble gobfoo—oof!”

lines.japanese: 言いおわる前に鳳翔の掌底が飛んできた。ややガチの。
lines.english: Before I could finish, Kakeru Otori struck me with the heel of his palm. He put some real force into it.

lines.japanese: 「つ、痛ゥー……すんげえ威力だな、頭クラッと来たぞいま……」
lines.english: “Ow... That had some real power behind it. Made my head spin...”

lines.japanese: 「火はァ……点いたか……？」
lines.english: “Is the fire... lit now...?”

lines.japanese: 鳳翔が熱い息吹を吐いていた。俺の中の誰かは、煽られて少年時代の冒険心を赤く燃えたぎらせていた。
lines.english: Kakeru Otori's breath came hot and hard. Someone inside me rose to his provocation, his childhood hunger for adventure blazing red.

lines.japanese: 「な、なにしてるんですか鳳さん！」
lines.english: “Wh-what are you doing, Mr. Otori!?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、ちょっとカケル、ツッコミにしても笑えないって！　おい、大丈夫か千歳っ！」
lines.english: “H-hey, Kakeru! Even if that was supposed to knock some sense into him, it wasn't funny! Chitose, are you okay?”

lines.japanese: 「え、ええっ！？　鬼の日和子と悪魔の英里子が俺を心配しているッ！？」
lines.english: “Wh-what!? Demonic Hiyoko and devilish Eriko are worried about me!?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえ意外と余裕あるのな……」
lines.english: “You're taking this surprisingly well...”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、そりゃあ小鳩を守るために鍛えてきたからな。このぐらいは大したことないぞ。ていうか、むしろ──」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! I trained to protect Kobato. A blow like that is nothing. In fact—”

lines.japanese: 「──いいだろう、フェニックスことカケルくん。俺たちもやられっぱなしじゃ男がすたる。いっちょまた遊んでいくか？」
lines.english: “—very well, Phoenix, otherwise known as Kakeru. We can't take this lying down and still call ourselves men. Shall we play again?”

lines.japanese: 「ククク……！　なんだかナチュラルにアガってきちゃったよシュウちゃん……フハハハ！」
lines.english: “Heh heh heh...! I'm getting fired up without even trying, Shu... Fuhahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「はははははは！　っしゃああああ！　いいよねおじいさん、俺もう怒ったって大丈夫だよね！　うおおーッ、行っくぞおおおおー！　超ウルトラスーパーダイナミックコンドリアンダイナマイ──」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha ha ha! All riiight! It's okay, Grandfather, isn't it? I can get angry now, right? Ooooooh! Here I come! Super Ultra Hyper Dynamic Condorian Dynami—”

lines.japanese: 「おい、クソジャリども」
lines.english: “Listen, you shitty brats.”

lines.japanese: 「あだっ」
lines.english: “Ow!”

lines.japanese: 「いてっ」
lines.english: “Oof!”

lines.japanese: しかし熱くなったのも束の間、店長兼バウンサーに首根を掴まれ、寒空の下へおっぽり出されてしまった。
lines.english: But our excitement lasted only a moment. The manager-slash-bouncer grabbed us by the scruffs of our necks and tossed us out into the cold.

lines.japanese: 「殴りっこしたいならここでやれ。終わるまで帰ってくんじゃねえぞ」
lines.english: “If you want to trade punches, do it here. Don't come back until you're finished.”

lines.japanese: いてて……さすがは過去に伝説を築いている一城の主。本気を出されると俺や鳳翔でもまだ敵わないな。夜空が遠いや。
lines.english: Ow... He really was the master of his castle, with the legendary past to prove it. When he got serious, even Kakeru Otori and I were no match for him yet. The night sky looked very far away.

lines.japanese: 「あークソ……熱くなりかけてたのに、一気に冷めた」
lines.english: “Ah, damn it... I was almost fired up, and now it's gone cold.”

lines.japanese: 鳳翔は吐きすてながら起きあがると、上から俺の顔を覗きこんだ。
lines.english: Kakeru Otori spat the words out as he stood, then looked down into my face.

lines.japanese: 「で？　シュウちゃんでも隼人でもないよね。おまえ誰なの？」
lines.english: “So? You're neither Shu nor Hayato. Who are you?”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Mm.”

lines.japanese: なるほど、いい質問だ。俺はいったい誰なんだろう。
lines.english: An excellent question. Who was I, exactly?

lines.japanese: 「いや、俺は誰でもない。おまえの定義する俺がおまえにとっての俺。おまえが俺を千歳鷲介だと思えばイーグルだし、成田隼人だと思えばファルコンだし、伊丹伽楼羅だと思えばガルーダだ」
lines.english: “No. I am nobody. I am whatever your definition makes me to you. If you believe I am Shusuke Chitose, I am Eagle. If you believe I am Hayato Narita, I am Falcon. If you believe I am Karura Itami, I am Garuda.”

lines.japanese: 「はあー、なんでそんなことになったの」
lines.english: “Huh. How'd that happen?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだな、ひとりじゃ出来ないことも、みんなで力を合わせれば怖くないかなって思ったんだ。つまり今の俺は五神合体ハネダイガー、言ってみればウルトラ羽田マンだ、じゅわっち」
lines.english: “Let's see. I thought that even things one person couldn't do would be nothing to fear if everyone joined forces. In other words, I am now Five-God Fusion Hanedaiger—Ultra Hanedaman, you might say. Shuwatch!”

lines.japanese: 「なあんだ、つまり普通のひとになっちゃったんだ」
lines.english: “Oh. So you just turned into a normal person.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ウルトラ羽田だって言ってんじゃん。各々が持っていた役割をひとつに合わせ、欠けるところのない完璧人間となったんだ。ああそうだ、これには鳳翔の力添えもあったんだ。ははは、礼を言うぞフェニックス」
lines.english: “I said *Ultra Haneda*. We joined all our separate roles into one and became a complete human being, lacking nothing. Oh, yes—Kakeru Otori helped make it possible. Ha ha ha! You have my thanks, Phoenix.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、まいった。せっかく起こしたのに、そのせいで引っこまれたんじゃやってらんねーや」
lines.english: “Aw, come on. I finally woke him up, and that just made him retreat? Why'd I even bother?”

lines.japanese: 鳳翔は俺の広げた両手を無視して溜息をついた。だが、むっつりと続ける。
lines.english: Kakeru Otori ignored my outspread arms and sighed. Then, still sullen, he continued.

lines.japanese: 「でも、またなんかの拍子にキレたら、めんどくさくなって伽楼羅一本になることもあるわけでしょ？」
lines.english: “Still, if you snap again for some reason, you might get sick of the arrangement and go all-in on Karura, right?”

lines.japanese: 「おいおい、怖いこと言わないでくれよ。そんな予定は微塵もないぞ」
lines.english: “Whoa, don't scare me like that. I have absolutely no plans to do that.”

lines.japanese: 「アハハ、じゃあもうしばらく観察させてもらうよ。たぶんあと一生分ぐらい？」
lines.english: “Ahaha! Then I guess I'll keep observing a little longer. Maybe another lifetime or so?”

lines.japanese: 「知らん、同意を求めるな。ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “I don't care. Don't seek my agreement. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「うーわ、糞ウゼェー。なんだソレ隼人みてえじゃん」
lines.english: “God, that's annoying. What the hell? You sound just like Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 笑顔のまま暴言。いつもの鳳翔──鷲介のよく知るカケルくんが戻ってきた。
lines.english: Abuse delivered with a smile. The usual Kakeru Otori—the Kakeru whom Shusuke knew well—had returned.

lines.japanese: 「ところで伽楼羅ぁ」
lines.english: “By the way, Karura.”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　なんだ、けっきょく伽楼羅なのか俺」
lines.english: “Hm? So I'm Karura after all?”

lines.japanese: 「知ってる？　視覚情報ってのは視細胞から電気信号になって大脳へ達するんだよ。だから、おまえらが鏡の前に立てば、各自でそれぞれ違う姿が見えるんだろうけど──」
lines.english: “Did you know visual information is converted by the photoreceptor cells into electrical signals and sent to the cerebrum? So when you people stand before a mirror, each of you may see a different figure—”

lines.japanese: 「な、なんだいきなり」
lines.english: “Wh-where did that come from?”

lines.japanese: 「うん？　要はアレか。俺たちが知る俺たちそれぞれの顔や姿は、俺たちの脳味噌が勝手に錯覚してるだけって言いたいのか？」
lines.english: “Hm? Is that your point? The faces and bodies each of us knows as our own are just illusions our brains have made up?”

lines.japanese: 「そ。だからシュウちゃんも隼人も他のやつも、外側の俺から見たら『伽楼羅風の別人』なんだよね」
lines.english: “Right. So from outside, to me, Shu and Hayato and all the others are just different people who happen to look like Karura.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど。隼人あたりが聞いたら怒りそうだが、真実はその通りなんだろうな。だが、いまの俺はそんな細かいこと気にしないぞ。好きに呼んでくれ」
lines.english: “I see. Hayato would probably be furious to hear it, but that is likely the truth. Still, the present me does not care about such details. Call me whatever you like.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、いちいち不思議がられんのも面倒くさいから、人前では通りのいい名前で呼んでやるよ」
lines.english: “It'd be a pain if people wondered about it every time, so in public I'll use whichever name won't raise questions.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか。ありがとう、それは正直助かる」
lines.english: “I see. Thank you. That will honestly help.”

lines.japanese: 「おっと、そろそろ戻ろう鳳翔。みんな待ってるぞ。いまからカラオケに行くからな……ああ、返事はいい。おまえに拒否権はない。首に縄付けてでも連れていく」
lines.english: “Oh, we should get back, Kakeru Otori. Everyone is waiting. We are going to karaoke now... No, don't answer. You have no right of refusal. I'll drag you there on a leash if I have to.”

lines.japanese: 「アハハ、なんだソレ。ガキの言い分じゃん」
lines.english: “Ahaha! What's that? A little kid's argument.”

lines.japanese: 「おうっ、俺は永遠のガキ大将だからな！」
lines.english: “Yeah! I'm the eternal king of the kids!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、んじゃフレイムバーズもらってよ。アタマ不在でみんな困ってるみたいだから」
lines.english: “Oh. Then take the Flame Birds off my hands. Everybody seems lost without a boss.”

lines.japanese: 「ようし、いいだろう。俺が率いる戦慄の最強軍団タマタマ☆スケスケに勝てたら考えてやろう。さあ、ゆくぞフェニックス！　今宵はカラオケで勝負だ！　ウヴァアアアー！」
lines.english: “Very well. If you can defeat the terrifying invincible army I command, Balls-Out☆See-Through, I shall consider it. Come, Phoenix! Tonight we do battle at karaoke! UVAAAAAAH!”

lines.japanese: 「フハハハ！　望むところだ！　俺様の美声で鼓膜をとろけさせるがいい！　キシャアアアーオウ！」
lines.english: “Fuhahaha! Gladly! Let my glorious voice melt your eardrums! KSHAAAAAOW!”

lines.japanese: その夜、俺たちは童心にかえって叫びまくった。
lines.english: That night, we became kids again and shouted ourselves hoarse.

lines.japanese: 玉泉にはものすごーく嫌な顔をされたけど、２対１なので叫び勝ちした。声を出すって気持ちいいよな。
lines.english: Tamaizumi looked extraordinarily disgusted, but we outnumbered her two to one and won by sheer volume. It feels good to let it all out.

lines.japanese: ちなみにタマタマ☆スケスケは音楽性の違いにより解散した。
lines.english: For the record, Balls-Out☆See-Through broke up over musical differences.
